question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84b08c1e2f04f860b443364d9c4489de7728b3bb81d344736249095a3eb58ef6.png]
solution: The number of triangles in the given figure are shown below: 1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2 = [2 × 3] ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2
